narrative_summary: Q1 2026 (reported ~Apr 30): net income $134.2M, basic EPS $1.31, revenue $830.7M, Adj EBITDA $325.6M; Aerospace Products revenue/EBITDA more than doubled YoY (aerospace revenue +104% to $743.8M). Quarterly dividend raised to $0.45/share (third straight increase). New JV with Jereh Group for Mod-1 CFM56 aeroderivative production. FTAI Power: convert retired CFM56 engines into gas turbines for AI data center power. Long-term projection: $5.7B revenue and $1.6B earnings by 2029 (31.7% yearly revenue CAGR). Next earnings: not explicitly dated in searches; based on quarterly cadence after Q1 (Apr 30) report, next is approximately late July 2026 (Q2).
